feature: POA&Ms (#4037, Feature #1935) -- the real customer-facing POA&Ms page in artifacts/portal (/poams), wired to the six live artifacts/api-server/src/routes/portal-poams.ts routes -- see docs/portal/poams-contract-pack.md. No fixture module: every row on screen comes from these endpoints. The sibling exit to the Risk Register ('we ARE fixing this, here is the plan' vs. 'we accept the consequence').
notes: TIER GATE IS THE REAL CURRENT STATE FOR EVERY TENANT (#3104): confirmed this session via a direct SELECT against the local DATABASE_URL -- no monitoring_tier row's type_attributes.includedFeatures array anywhere in the local DB contains 'poams'. So GET /api/portal/poams and GET /api/portal/poams/:poamId 402 for the designated test account exactly like they would for any real customer today; A1/A2 below assert that live 402, not a hypothetical.

#4050: GET /api/portal/poams/available-checks (added this session) serves this tenant's own current findings -- checkKey + checkLabel, sourced from msp_diagnostic_findings for the customer's own latest completed/partial scan -- so PoamCreatePanel.tsx's 'Check this plan answers' field can offer a real picker instead of free text alone. It carries the identical requireTierFeature(poams) gate as the other two customer-facing READ routes (A2b below), so it also 402s for every real tenant today.

CREATION AND SIGNING ARE UNCONDITIONAL (#1168): the two POST routes and the sign/delete/request-acceleration routes carry no tier check, so LIFECYCLE1-6 below drive a real end-to-end create -> sign -> re-sign-refused(409) -> soft-delete -> request-acceleration sequence against a plan this run creates for itself. Unlike the Risk Register's accept (permanent, one row, poisons re-runs), POA&M creation makes a fresh row every run, so this whole lifecycle is safely re-runnable: each run creates and then soft-deletes its own row, never touching another run's.

WHY NO FULL UI-DRIVEN CREATE SUBMIT: the create form has seven real inputs (title, date, optional checkKey, optional sowId, weakness, interim control, resources) and this project's own manifests document WebView2 form-driven flows as a recurring flakiness source (see e.g. portal-v2-manifest-login-block-persisted-session-flaky). The full real create/sign/delete lifecycle is already proven end-to-end and deterministically via LIFECYCLE1-6 below; the UI steps here instead prove the DOM actually renders the live 402 gated state and that the create panel opens with its real fields, which is what the honest-empty-state design calls out as the state every real tenant sees today.
ENV VARS (BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables): DEPLOY_URL, TEST_RBAC_CUSTOMER_EMAIL / TEST_RBAC_CUSTOMER_PASSWORD.

#4451: removed UI7, which asserted the internal 'what this page deliberately does not do' engineering disclosure (spec-section citations) was visible on screen -- that component was removed from the customer-facing render per #4451 (Shane flagged it across 7+ portal pages as internal scope commentary, not customer-appropriate copy). Not live-executed via shaneapp://runTest this session -- same worktree-merge-gap reason documented in this repo's other portal manifests (BuildConsole resolves test-manifests/ against the dev-server checkout, not this build's isolated worktree, until merge-back on completion). Verified instead via artifacts/portal `tsc --noEmit` clean and `vite build` clean against the edited page.

A2b -- #4050: the new available-checks picker source carries the same real tier gate as the other two customer-facing READ routes above.
A3 -- creation is unconditional (#1168): an invalid create body 400s on validation, not the tier gate -- proving this route has no requireTierFeature middleware at all.
A4 -- signing a nonexistent plan 404s (no tier gate on this route either).
A6 -- requesting acceleration on a nonexistent plan 404s.
